lead_raw_text:
The structure of V₂Ir₆ (VIr₃) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ir and V centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors: Ir is surrounded by 8 Ir and 4 V neighbors, while V has 12 Ir neighbors, all near 2.71 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ir-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- plus corner/face-sharing between Ir- and V-centered polyhedra.
